author: Seung Wook
problem: Let T be the string 'oxx' repeated 100000 times. Read a string S of 'o' and 'x' (length 1 to 10) and print Yes if S appears as a contiguous substring of T, otherwise No.
bug_description: The repeated pattern is built as 'oox' instead of 'oxx', so substrings of the real pattern such as 'xxo' are not found.

comments.accurate: Checks whether S occurs inside the long periodic string T by direct search
comments.wrong_behavior: Checks whether S occurs inside T, the pattern 'oox' repeated, by direct search
comments.wrong_location: Pattern string verified; check that find's -1 result is compared correctly
